name: Natsume Azusa
source:
Azusa is a second-year student and a close friend (and neighbor) of [url=/c16389]Tsukuyo[/url]'s. She has a very strict temperament, even making the "poor" [url=/c16391]Madoka[/url] tremble around her. At their first meeting, she was be quite cold towards [url=/c16393]Makoto[/url], whom she thought was a pervert. However, she was very sweet and kind to [url=/c16392]Arisa[/url], which shows that she is not a woman with a heart of stone.

Azusa is an honors student who gets above average grades in every subject, and works very hard. However, Azusa has no particular talents, whether it's in art or technology; in other words, she is ordinary and completely normal. Although she is jealous of Tsukuyo's talent and skills, but because she worries about her airheaded side, she is constantly looking after her. The relationship between the two is that of very close friends.

When someone says something that bothers her, she tends to pinch their cheeks.

Azusa is terrified of gaining weight and monitors her physical appearance strictly. As soon as she finds that her belly starts to become flaccid, she panics and no longer dares to put herself in a bathing suit; in other words, she is constantly on a diet.

Every year, she offers Tsukuyo some chocolate cakes because she knows that her friend loves sweets.

Her favorite artistic fields are drawing and wood carving.

[spoiler]During the game, Azusa passes her second year and moves to the next grade (third year).

She is the object of sexual fantasies of many boys in her school. Indeed, Azusa is very popular with men, in high school and even outside, not for her character but because she is very attractive, being even seen as a sex symbol. It sometimes causes her great problems...[/spoiler]
